caption:
Messy decimals? Let Desmos find the peak.

Graph the height function with x instead of t, zoom out, and click the top of the arc. The y-coordinate is the max height.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Max height with ugly decimals? Click the top of the arc in Desmos.

youtube.title: Maximum Height Questions in Desmos: Click the Peak
youtube.description: Graph the rocket's height, zoom out, and click the vertex to read the maximum height. SAT-style practice question (original).
